snippet.title: Shelf Happens - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Shelf Happens announcement trailer for this upcoming sim game. You (alone or with friends) need to place scattered movie tapes on the right genre shelves in a retro video store. Complete shelves and earn XP to unlock abilities that improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to sort hundreds of tapes by genre fast! Shelf Happens will be available on PC via Steam.
